column1: # Key for cv1549 (27 May 1549), frozen before the decode. Every value comes from targets/gonzaga1549/sign_table.tsv as on
# dbourdeau/cyphersolver main (md5 dd3266dc1f24a2a71ae1d3aec658da7d, identical on mmcbratney main, fetched 15 Nov 2026),
# read together with the image it was made from (Tomokiyo, Cryptiana CharlesV3.gif, Bertomeu Masia's reconstruction).
# No value was taken from this letter, from its decipherment (cc. 12-15) or from sign_values.tsv.
# basis: table = value written in the table row; rule = the table's header rule (one dot a, bar e, two dots i, o-loop o, p-tail u)
#        applied to a base the row names; image = the table row names it and the key image shows the cell; none = no value (decodes '?').
# Columns: label TAB value TAB basis TAB table row / note

column4: qua que qui: crossed c-w (key image: c with slash)
na ne ni no nu: ne = theta-like with bar
da de di do du: de also x with o-loop
l: dash + o (g is drawn o-first; this hand draws dash first)
ff ll rr ss tt: dash = ss
ll = L (here drawn as an open angle)
tt = t with bar (key image: cross with hooked arm)
la le li lo lu: 6 base
ca ce ci co cu: 8 base
ra re ri ro ru: g/8-foot base
bare g/8-foot base: no value in the table
pa pe pi po pu: Lambda base; also V base
sa se si so su: y base
key image se = y with bar across the stem
va ve vi vo vu: y-s base
ta te ti to tu: te = triangle with a stroke through it
ma me mi mo mu: L base
key image me = L joined to a 4 (L with bar)
tra tre tri tro: inverted T base (tra = bar + dot)
ja je ji jo ju: 3 base; key image je = 3 with dot above
3 with a dot to the right: not in the table
ga ge gi go gu: ring base
ni = open j with two dots
fa fe fi fo fu: n base
ba be bi bo bu: 7 base
za ze zi: crossed V base; key image za = crossed v with dot
bare q: the table has z = q-p only
bare X: pre pri pro pru X base, no bare value
not in the table (dots below: the 8 nulls are not pictured)
ha he hi ho hu: e-hook base
d: sideways loop (the key image puts the sideways loop under do; the table row says d)
letters m: not in the table
separator stroke; skipped, not a unit
